Strings: GET / SET / MGET against Redis string keys. The simplest key-value layer — read and write opaque values.
Hashes: HGET / HSET / HGETALL / HSCAN — for field-keyed records stored under one Redis key. The `_over_scan` variant pairs SCAN with HSCAN for high-throughput bulk reads.
Lists: LPUSH / LRANGE — interact with Redis lists. Use `redis_lrange_table` when you want one row per list element (easier than parsing the comma-separated form).
Keys: DEL / EXISTS / TYPE / SCAN / KEYS — keyspace introspection and management. Use SCAN for production traffic; KEYS blocks the server on large keyspaces.
